remainingLimits: Local macroscopic cystic artery only, source-calibre course and literal original 18-control profile. The artery communicates with actual native right-hepatic blood space and enters the gallbladder tissue wall without crossing its innermost surface. Finite wall thickness and terminal perfusion bed are illustrative. The cystic vein is represented separately and joins actual right-portal blood space. The fixed cystic artery retains 603 crossing face pairs with the whole hepatic-biliary mesh; microscopic perfusion is unresolved.

Local macroscopic cystic vein, transported from its own HRA source sections without section shrinkage. A connected smooth transverse corridor clears the fixed installed cystic artery and checked biliary/native vascular tissues. The vein communicates with actual native right-portal blood space and enters the same gallbladder fundus wall region with a 0.300 mm terminal-annulus shift, without breaching its innermost surface. First eight portal sections remain literal. Finite wall thickness and microscopic terminal perfusion are illustrative; sampled maximum station turn is 31.14 degrees and requires actual emitted-course review. The fixed pre-existing cystic artery retains 603 crossing face pairs with the whole hepatic-biliary mesh; no new vein/context crossing is detected.

LOCAL:male:BOWELWALL:duodenum:circular-f.coverageLimitation: Finite native duodenal tissue with shared major/minor duct openings. Thickness, fold dimensions, other organ junctions and peritoneal coverage remain provisional.
LOCAL:male:BOWELWALL:duodenum:circular-f.description: Local finite-wall prototype, not anatomically accepted. Estimated thickness/fold dimensions, source defects, organ joining and peritoneal coverage remain unverified. Carrier comes from the separate LOCAL male stomach_duodenum source; registration to ZA vessels, nerves and ducts is not established. External coverings are diagnostic intervals, not a mapped serosa/adventitia distribution. Shallow procedural surface granularity changes lighting only; individual villi, crypt openings and gland distribution remain unrepresented on this carrier.

parts.name: Infra-orbital artery (left)

remainingLimits: Tooth fit remains unresolved: original c6 has94 second-molar-root crossing pairs per side, plus6 emitted closure-surface pairs per side. No clinical tooth-clearance acceptance is claimed.

Independent all59 fixed-neighbor context review found no additional new nerve, non-tooth bone, vessel or muscle crossings. Emitted conical closure fragments differ from the old diagnostic classifier boundary by at most6.27nm; this is occupancy evidence, not clinical fit.

The source c1 proximal strips0–3 are trimmed, and the remaining provisional unnamed alveolar-side branch joins infraorbital through a constructed patch. No anterior superior alveolar .079 or other new TA98 code is assigned.
This local exterior junction preview establishes no finite arterial wall, complete perfusion, or repaired external-carotid inlet/distal organ interfaces.

parts.name: Maxillary artery (left)

remainingLimits: Tooth fit remains unresolved: original c6 has94 second-molar-root crossing pairs per side, plus6 emitted closure-surface pairs per side. No clinical tooth-clearance acceptance is claimed.

Independent all59 fixed-neighbor context review found no additional new nerve, non-tooth bone, vessel or muscle crossings. Emitted conical closure fragments differ from the old diagnostic classifier boundary by at most6.27nm; this is occupancy evidence, not clinical fit.

The source c1 proximal strips0–3 are trimmed, and the remaining provisional unnamed alveolar-side branch joins infraorbital through a constructed patch. No anterior superior alveolar .079 or other new TA98 code is assigned.
This local exterior junction preview establishes no finite arterial wall, complete perfusion, or repaired external-carotid inlet/distal organ interfaces.

organFit.method: Vessel surfaces inside or within 0.4 mm of visible bone are moved out along a locally averaged exit direction; the displacement is extended smoothly over the vessel mesh, and vertices closer than 0.3 mm (seams and branch mouths) share one displacement. Heart-contact vertices and everything outside the height range are fixed.

dmta.method: midpoint subdivision (exact shape) + name-driven seed placement + weighted Voronoi partition; provisional, unvalidated

dmtm.method: midpoint subdivision (exact shape) + name-driven seed placement + weighted Voronoi partition; provisional, unvalidated

skinClearance.method: Vertices outside or within the clearance of the visible skin get a target at the nearest skin point moved inward along the skin normal; displacements are averaged over a ball so cross-sections move as one, repeated until clear. Parts mostly outside by more than the gross limit are hidden instead.
